column2: The scan is keyed on the SPELLING of the argument (`"slope" in name.lower()`), so the same units error under any other name ships green — the criterion-J defect recorded in guard-domains.tsv (111/151 files, 12 of the 40 unreachable discussing the same quantity as gradient/dzdx/repose).

column4: Same anchor, three edits that do NOT introduce the defect: (a) `    _theta = np.arctan(s)` — the correct tangent->angle direction; (b) `    # taking the sine of s would be a units error` — the needle in a comment with no call to find.

column2: ANGLE_CALL was searched against the WHOLE argument, so one `arctan` anywhere inside pardoned every other operand beside it.

column4: Same anchor, `    _b = np.sin(np.arctan(s))` — the arctan actually wrapping the tangent, which is the endorsed `sin θ` identity.
